name: Chunk
description: A 16 by 16 column of the world; the unit that loads and tracks smog.

pages.title: Chunk
pages.text:
The world is stored in **chunks**, columns 16 by 16 blocks from top to bottom. F3 + G shows their borders.\
\
Smog, ore veins and oil deposits count per chunk. Chunks far from players **unload** and their machines stop; trains still travel through them. Chunk loaders keep chunks running.
